title: Nightscout treatments are not downloaded
symptom: Treatments entered in XDrip are shown on the master and in the Webinterface, but not on the Nightscout Follower. "Download Treatments" is turned on. When a treatment is entered in the Webinterface it shows up on the follower.
cause: The issue is that treatments uploaded by xDrip have an "Entered By" field set to "xdrip" (hard-coded XDRIP_TAG), and the Nightscout download code ignores new treatments that come from xdrip, so they are not downloaded by other xDrip instances.
fix: As of the release on February 24, 2024, there is a new switch in the "Upload Treatments" submenu titled "Skip items from xDrip" enabled by default. If you disable this switch, treatments uploaded by another xDrip will also be downloaded.
